result.executiveDecision: Hold enrollment and treatment due to multiple screening laboratory failures (hemoglobin, ANC, platelets, creatinine, ALT, AST) and unresolved protocol requirements.
result.executiveSummary: Participant PT-1042 presents multiple screening laboratory values outside protocol-specified thresholds, including hemoglobin (10.2 g/dL vs >=12.0 required), ANC (1.1 x10^9/L vs >=1.5 required), platelets (145 x10^9/L vs >=150 required), creatinine (1.4 mg/dL vs <=1.2 required), ALT (82 U/L vs <=45 required), and AST (76 U/L vs <=40 required). Additionally, an out-of-window Day 21 visit occurred for a Day 15 assessment due to transportation issues, and several non-laboratory screening criteria lack affirmative documentation. An adverse event of Grade 2 nausea and vomiting is ongoing with study drug temporarily held. Complete MedDRA coding, precise prednisone washout details, and protocol-specific dose modification thresholds are currently missing.
